name: Paladin Arboreal Knight
body:
Arboreal Knights defend the woods and the creatures that inhabit them from destruction and senseless exploitation—especially verdant creatures.

Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

An arboreal knight is not proficient with heavy armor.

This alters weapon and armor proficiencies.

Green Empathy (Ex)

The arboreal knight gains the green empathy ability of a treesinger druid.

Plant Master

An arboreal knight who is able to channel positive energy can select the Command Plants feat even if she doesn’t meet its prerequisites.

Arboreal Bond (Ex)

At 5th level, an arboreal knight whose bound is with her sword can grant the weapon the quenching and lifesurge qualities in place of flaming and flaming burst; a paladin whose bound is with a mount may acquire a mount with the verdant companion archetype or call a hunting cactus, slithering sundew, sapling treant, or snapping flytrap in place of a normal mount.

This alters divine bond.

Oath Spells 1st—pass without trace; 2nd—speak with plants; 3rd—command plants; 4th—arboreal hammer.
